caveat: No attack-labeled data was available in this handoff (only train_windows_n7.jsonl, benign windows). These are convergence and held-out-loss diagnostics, not detection accuracy. Real precision/recall/F1/AUC requires scoring a labeled benign+attack test set through this same model. Score direction note: unlike the HMM's log-likelihood (higher/less-negative = more normal), this is negative log-likelihood loss — HIGHER = more surprising = more anomalous. Don't compare the two raw numbers directly.
